{{Gemini}}
Gemini 14 is the 182nd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 14th day of Gemini, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 26, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 7宮14日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 182|Chapter 182]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152202}}.
